tracks.name: Getting started
tracks.artifact: A LifeOS set up the way you want it: your caps, your assistant wired in, your first real track defined

queue.title: How this system works, in fifteen minutes
queue.do: Read the one lesson that explains the deck, the overdue mechanic and the rituals. Then capture three things that are in your head right now.

queue.title: Wire in an assistant and run your first check-in
queue.do: Open this folder in Claude Code or another coding assistant, point it at CLAUDE.md, and run the check-in ritual. Inbox to zero, three tasks starred.

queue.title: Define your first real learning track
queue.do: Write learning/MISSION.md with your assistant, agree one track with a tangible artifact, then run the curate ritual to deal your first hand of cards.
